$comment: Names of private products and repositories that must never appear in this public repository. Each entry is a case-insensitive regular expression. `exceptions` lists repo-relative file paths allowed to match. It is meant to stay empty. Today it holds only the vendored copies of canonical AIP JSON Schemas and the code generated from them: they must match agentproto/agentproto byte for byte (spec drift check), so the names are removed upstream first, then synced here, then these entries are deleted.
